features.title: Manage provider account drafts
features.summary: Add, edit, enable, and persist account profiles while preserving unsaved edits across validation and save failures.

configuration.constraints: One of auto or manual.
Integer from 200 to 10000 milliseconds; used only by auto save.

failureModes: Invalid account path or environment alias is rejected.
A failed write preserves the draft and supports retry or revert.

features.title: Curate models and choose account routes
features.summary: Curate provider model lists and reasoning defaults, then route requests through sticky, priority, round-robin, or balanced pools of compatible same-provider, same-model accounts with matching request capabilities and cooldown-aware failover.

configuration.constraints: One of sticky, priority, round-robin, or balanced; non-sticky modes distribute within compatible accounts of the same provider kind and model.
Integer from 0 to 86400000 milliseconds.
Boolean; show account routing controls on the models page.

failureModes: A provider rate limit cools the account that served the request and may rebind its retry.
All eligible accounts are cooling down and no route can be selected.
Distribution never mixes provider kinds or models with incompatible request capabilities.

externalDependencies.boundary: Provider model catalog and account pool response adapters.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject synthetic catalogs and quota/rate-limit responses; never load OAuth state or call provider APIs.

verification.testName: routes Priority through the first healthy same-provider account that offers the model
moves an account within its provider order without changing other accounts

features.title: Read provider quota and usage status
features.summary: Render account quota windows, reset times, status indicators, and configurable footer or edge meters with hidden and ordered accounts.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 15 to 3600 seconds.
Boolean; show the footer quota control.
One of both, percent, or reset.
One of binding, horizontal, or vertical; multi-window layouts show every quota window for the account.
Ordered account ID list; unknown IDs are ignored.
Account ID list hidden from usage meters.
Boolean; enable the edge quota overlay.

failureModes: A quota provider failure is displayed without persisting a fake success.
Missing or stale accounts do not crash the quota strip.

externalDependencies.boundary: Quota refresh adapter per configured provider.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Return synthetic usage/reset/error payloads through injected provider clients with a fake clock.

features.title: Review usage history and cost forecasts
features.summary: Store bounded successful usage snapshots, chart historical and forecast usage, and apply explicit price overrides without persisting provider response payloads.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 1 to 720 hours.
Model ID to synthetic price override map; malformed entries are ignored safely.
The only supported currency is USD.

failureModes: Failed quota reads write no history row.
Missing model price yields an unavailable estimate rather than an invented cost.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Inject a fixed pricing catalog and simulated refresh timestamps; do not fetch models.dev in routine tests.

features.title: Route exhausted Luna accounts through Reserve
features.summary: Use the separate Reserve quota window and route to the Reserve model only after the weekly Luna window is spent.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; enable separate Luna Reserve routing and metering.
Boolean; enable composer cost estimates.

failureModes: Reserve exhaustion does not masquerade as weekly quota.
Disabled Reserve leaves the default route unchanged.

externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use canned weekly and Reserve windows; never authenticate or call Codex in CI.

features.title: Recover failed account requests per failure kind
features.summary: Retry, Luna Reserve, fail over to a compatible account, wait, shrink re-sent images, then fail or hand to DSH, configured per failure kind.

configuration.defaultValue: transport: retry 2x then fail over; rateLimit: fail over then wait 60 s; exhausted: Luna Reserve then fail over; auth and oversized: hand to DSH
configuration.constraints: Per kind (transport, rateLimit, exhausted, auth, oversized): retries 0-10, backoffMs 100-60000, lunaReserve, failover, waitSeconds 0-3600, shrink, then fail|dsh; malformed fields fall back to defaults.

failureModes: A fail-over never crosses provider kinds, skips hidden accounts and accounts without the model.
A recovered account takes its conversations back after its cooldown.
Settings written before failure recovery keep loading with defaults.

verification.testName: retries a transport failure with doubling backoff, fails over, retries the stand-in, then fails
moves a rate-limited conversation to the next healthy account and cools the spent one

features.title: Retry exhausted quota when its reset arrives
features.summary: Explain exhausted provider limits inline and let each eligible turn opt into retrying at its known reset, with global default and visibility preferences.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; pre-check the per-turn retry choice when exhausted-limit failover is disabled.
Boolean; show the per-turn checkbox only when exhausted-limit failover is disabled.

failureModes: Automatic retry stays off by default and cannot be enabled without a known reset time.
Changing one turn's choice creates or removes only that turn's scheduled recovery.
The inline choice is absent while automatic exhausted-limit failover is enabled.

verification.testName: lets one waiting continuation opt into and out of retry-at-reset

features.title: Open credential setup from failed turns
features.summary: Offer an inline route to AI Accounts when a failed turn reports missing or rejected provider credentials.
failureModes: A failed turn with missing credentials does not need to be retried before setup is reachable.
Unrelated failures do not show an irrelevant credential action.

verification.testName: offers setup for a missing credential failure
